variants.text: A middle-aged adult with an oval face, rounded hairline, thin arched eyebrows, almond eyes, and a narrow nose, wearing drop earrings.

A middle-aged adult featuring an oval face, moderately wide jawline, rounded hairline with temporal recession, high-arched thin eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose with a rounded tip, accessorized with drop earrings.

A middle-aged adult with an oval face, moderately wide jawline, and no persistent asymmetries. Features include a rounded hairline with moderate temporal recession, thin high-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double creases, and a narrow nose with a straight dorsum and rounded tip. The individual has thin lips, visible upper teeth, smooth skin, and wears drop earrings on free ear lobes.

This middle-aged person has an oval-shaped face with a noticeable jawline and a rounded hairline that recedes slightly at the temples. They have thin, high-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a narrow nose with a rounded tip. You can see their upper teeth when they smile, and they are wearing a pair of drop earrings.
